nl.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
nl.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
nl.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
nl.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
nl.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
nl.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
nl.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
nl.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
nl.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
nl.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
nl.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
nl.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
nl.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
nl.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
nl.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
nl.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
nl.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
nl.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
nl.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
nl.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
nl.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
nl.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
nl.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
nl.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
nl.legal.terms.service.title: The service
nl.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
nl.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
nl.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
nl.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
nl.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
nl.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
nl.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
nl.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
nl.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
nl.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
nl.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
nl.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
nl.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
nl.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
nl.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
nl.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
nl.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
nl.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
nl.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
nl.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

sv.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.

sv.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
sv.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
sv.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.

sv.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.

sv.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
sv.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
sv.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights

de.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
de.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
de.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
de.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
de.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
de.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
de.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
de.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
de.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.

de.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
de.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
de.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
de.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
de.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
de.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
de.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
de.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
de.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).

We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. it.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
it.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
it.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
it.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
it.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
it.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
it.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
it.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
it.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
it.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
it.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
it.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
it.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
it.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
it.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
it.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
it.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
it.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
it.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
it.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
it.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.

We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
pt-PT.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
pt-PT.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
pt-PT.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
pt-PT.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
pt-PT.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
pt-PT.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
pt-PT.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
pt-PT.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
pt-PT.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
pt-PT.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
pt-PT.legal.terms.service.title: The service
pt-PT.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
pt-PT.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
pt-PT.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
pt-PT.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
pt-PT.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
pt-PT.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
pt-PT.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
pt-PT.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
pt-PT.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
pt-PT.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
pt-PT.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
pt-PT.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
pt-PT.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
pt-PT.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
pt-PT.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
pt-PT.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
pt-PT.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
pt-PT.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
pt-PT.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
pt-PT.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

tr.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tr.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
tr.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
tr.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
tr.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
tr.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
tr.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
tr.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
tr.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
tr.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
tr.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
tr.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
tr.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
tr.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
tr.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
tr.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
tr.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
tr.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
tr.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
tr.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
tr.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
tr.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
tr.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
tr.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
tr.legal.terms.service.title: The service
tr.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
tr.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
tr.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
tr.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
tr.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
tr.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
tr.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
tr.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
tr.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
tr.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
tr.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
tr.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
tr.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
tr.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
tr.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
tr.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
tr.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
tr.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
tr.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
tr.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

ru.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect

ru.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data

ar.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
ar.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
ar.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
ar.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
ar.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
ar.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
ar.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
ar.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.

ar.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
ar.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
ar.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
ar.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
ar.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
ar.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
ar.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
ar.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
ar.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
ar.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes

fa.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
fa.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
fa.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
fa.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
fa.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
fa.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
fa.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
fa.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
fa.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
fa.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
fa.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
fa.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
fa.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
fa.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
fa.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
fa.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
fa.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
fa.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
fa.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
fa.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
fa.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
fa.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
fa.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
fa.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
fa.legal.terms.service.title: The service
fa.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
fa.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
fa.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
fa.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
fa.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
fa.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
fa.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
fa.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
fa.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
fa.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
fa.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers

We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
fa.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
fa.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
fa.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
fa.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.

bn.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
bn.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
bn.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
bn.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
bn.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
bn.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
bn.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
bn.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
bn.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
bn.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
bn.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
bn.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
bn.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
bn.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
bn.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
bn.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
bn.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
bn.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
bn.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
bn.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
bn.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
bn.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
bn.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
bn.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
bn.legal.terms.service.title: The service
bn.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
bn.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
bn.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
bn.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
bn.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
bn.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
bn.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
bn.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
bn.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
bn.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.

bn.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes

bn.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
bn.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.

zh-Hans.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
zh-Hans.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
zh-Hans.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
zh-Hans.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.service.title: The service
zh-Hans.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
zh-Hans.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
zh-Hans.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
zh-Hans.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
zh-Hans.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
zh-Hans.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
zh-Hans.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
zh-Hans.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
zh-Hans.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
zh-Hans.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
zh-Hans.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
zh-Hans.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.

id.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
id.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
id.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
id.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
id.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
id.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
id.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
id.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.

id.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
id.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
id.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
id.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
id.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
id.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
id.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
id.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
id.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).

tl.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tl.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
tl.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
tl.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
tl.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
tl.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
tl.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
tl.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
tl.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
tl.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
tl.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
tl.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
tl.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
tl.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
tl.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
tl.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
tl.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
tl.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
tl.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).

cs.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
cs.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.

cs.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).

cs.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
cs.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.

We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.

bg.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
bg.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
bg.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
bg.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
bg.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
bg.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
bg.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
bg.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
bg.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
bg.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
bg.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
bg.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
bg.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
bg.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
bg.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
bg.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
bg.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
bg.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
bg.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
bg.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
bg.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
bg.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
bg.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
bg.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
bg.legal.terms.service.title: The service
bg.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
bg.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
bg.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
bg.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
bg.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
bg.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
bg.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
bg.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
bg.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
bg.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
bg.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
bg.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
bg.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
bg.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
bg.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
bg.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
bg.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
bg.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
bg.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
bg.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

da.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
da.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
da.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
da.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
da.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
da.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
da.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
da.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
da.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
da.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
da.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
da.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
da.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
da.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
da.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
da.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
da.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
da.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
da.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
da.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
da.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
da.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
da.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
da.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
da.legal.terms.service.title: The service
da.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
da.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
da.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
da.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
da.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
da.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
da.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
da.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
da.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
da.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
da.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
da.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
da.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
da.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
da.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
da.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
da.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
da.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
da.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
da.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

fi.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
fi.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
fi.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
fi.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
fi.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
fi.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
fi.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
fi.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
fi.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
fi.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
fi.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
fi.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
fi.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
fi.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
fi.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
fi.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
fi.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
fi.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
fi.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
fi.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
fi.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
fi.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
fi.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
fi.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
fi.legal.terms.service.title: The service
fi.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
fi.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
fi.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
fi.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
fi.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
fi.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
fi.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
fi.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
fi.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
fi.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
fi.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
fi.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
fi.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
fi.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
fi.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
fi.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
fi.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
fi.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
fi.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
fi.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.
