lv.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
lv.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
lv.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
lv.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
lv.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
lv.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
lv.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
lv.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
lv.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
lv.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
lv.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
lv.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
lv.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
lv.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
lv.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
lv.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
lv.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
lv.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
lv.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
lv.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
lv.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
lv.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
lv.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
lv.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
lv.legal.terms.service.title: The service
lv.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
lv.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
lv.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
lv.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
lv.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
lv.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
lv.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
lv.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
lv.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
lv.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
lv.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
lv.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
lv.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
lv.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
lv.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
lv.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
lv.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
lv.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
lv.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
lv.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

ga.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
ga.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
ga.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
ga.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
ga.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
ga.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
ga.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
ga.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
ga.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
ga.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
ga.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
ga.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
ga.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
ga.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
ga.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
ga.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
ga.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
ga.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
ga.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
ga.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
ga.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
ga.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
ga.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
ga.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
ga.legal.terms.service.title: The service
ga.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
ga.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
ga.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
ga.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
ga.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
ga.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
ga.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
ga.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
ga.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
ga.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
ga.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
ga.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
ga.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
ga.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
ga.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
ga.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
ga.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
ga.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
ga.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
ga.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.

eu.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
eu.legal.privacy.intro: Outception (“we”, “us”) operates the Outception news wall - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It is written for compliance with the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We are based in Ireland; for privacy questions contact us at {email}.
eu.legal.privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
eu.legal.privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following, depending on how you use Outception:
eu.legal.privacy.collect.preferences: the news sources you follow and your cards, theme, and language settings. These are stored on your device.
eu.legal.privacy.collect.device: IP address, device and app type, app version, and a randomly-generated identifier used to distinguish sessions. We derive an approximate country from your IP to set your language and show local weather.
eu.legal.privacy.collect.location: only if you grant location permission, and only to fetch weather for your area. You can deny or revoke this at any time in your device settings.
eu.legal.privacy.collect.diagnostics: crash reports and error logs to keep the service working.
eu.legal.privacy.collect.noAccount: Outception works without an account - we do not offer sign-in, ask for payment information, or knowingly collect data from children under 16.
eu.legal.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
eu.legal.privacy.advertising.body: Outception does not serve advertising and does not use advertising networks, ad cookies, or device advertising identifiers.
eu.legal.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
eu.legal.privacy.analytics.body: To understand how Outception is used and improve it, we use product-analytics and error-monitoring tools that may set identifiers and process usage and device data on our behalf: PostHog and Sentry.
eu.legal.privacy.why.title: Why we process your data
eu.legal.privacy.why.legitimate: to keep the service secure, functional, and free.
eu.legal.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing your data
eu.legal.privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that make Outception work - our EU hosting provider, Google (analytics), PostHog, and Sentry - each acting under contract. When you tap a headline you leave Outception for the publisher’s own site, which has its own privacy practices we don’t control.
eu.legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention & your rights
eu.legal.privacy.retention.body: Because Outception works without an account, your preferences stay on your device - clear them any time in your app settings. Under the GDPR you can request access to, correction, or deletion of any personal data our providers process, object to or restrict processing, withdraw consent, and request a copy. Contact us at {email}. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority (in Ireland, the Data Protection Commission).
eu.legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
eu.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We’ll revise the “last updated” date above and, for material changes, provide a more prominent notice.
eu.legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
eu.legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
eu.legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Outception (“we”, “us”) - a website and mobile app that aggregates headlines from public news sources and links you out to the original publishers. By using Outception, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. We are based in Ireland.
eu.legal.terms.service.title: The service
eu.legal.terms.service.body: Outception is a live news wall. We collect and display headlines and links from third-party sources, organised by topic, and send you to the publisher’s own site or app to read the full story. We do not host, author, or claim ownership of that content. Reading the wall is free and requires no account.
eu.legal.terms.use.title: Acceptable use
eu.legal.terms.use.law: use the service in a way that breaks any law or infringes someone else’s rights;
eu.legal.terms.use.disrupt: attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the service or its infrastructure;
eu.legal.terms.use.scrape: scrape, resell, or systematically copy the service or its aggregated content except through an API we expressly provide, subject to its terms;
eu.legal.terms.use.security: interfere with or attempt to circumvent security features.
eu.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: Third-party content and links
eu.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: Headlines, article text, images, and trademarks shown on the wall belong to their respective publishers and rights holders. Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those sites, and your use of them is governed by their own terms.
eu.legal.terms.ip.title: Our intellectual property
eu.legal.terms.ip.body: The Outception name, logo, design, and software are ours or our licensors’ and are protected by intellectual-property laws. These terms grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the service; they do not transfer any ownership. The application source is released separately under the Apache License 2.0 as stated in the project repository.
eu.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
eu.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We do not warrant that headlines are complete, accurate, current, or available without interruption.
eu.legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
eu.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Outception is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for loss of data, profits, or goodwill, arising from your use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
eu.legal.terms.changes.title: Changes
eu.legal.terms.changes.body: We may update the service or these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the “last updated” date above. Continuing to use Outception after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
eu.legal.terms.law.title: Governing law
eu.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Ireland have jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live.
eu.legal.terms.contact.title: Contact
eu.legal.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us at {email}.
